name: api_allowed_ips
label: API Allowed IPs

description: Daily transaction volume limit for the merchant; blank means no configured limit.

label: Monthly Volume Limit
description: Monthly transaction volume limit for the merchant; blank means no configured limit.

label: SMS Customer Charge
description: Merchant-specific SMS customer charge override; blank uses the global SMS customer charge.
